name: Omaoutlook
author: Divanyx
description: Microsoft Outlook for Omarchy: the real Outlook web client in its own window, re-skinned live with your Omarchy theme and behaving like the Outlook app. Every sign-in works, links in mail open in your browser, popouts and new mails get Outlook windows, mailto starts a message, Teams links go to Teams. Unread badge in the bar, notifications, printing, and a memory watchdog for weeks of uptime.

barWidget.description: Unread mail badge in the bar; Outlook itself opens as its own Omarchy-themed window. Middle click writes a new message.

schema.label: Show the icon in the bar
schema.description: Turn this off to keep Outlook running without an icon in the bar. Bind a key to open it instead: o.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + O", "Outlook", "omaoutlook toggle")

schema.label: Show the unread count next to the icon
Start Outlook hidden with the shell
schema.description: Launches the Outlook window in the background when the bar loads, so the unread badge, new-mail notifications and calendar reminders work before you open it. Costs the memory of one browser tab.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Forwards Outlook's new-mail and reminder notifications to the Omarchy notification daemon. Clicking one opens the message. Outlook asks once (Settings › General › Notifications).

schema.label: Open mailto links in Outlook
schema.description: Makes Omaoutlook the desktop's handler for mailto links, so a mail address clicked in any app starts a new Outlook message. Off hands the links back.

schema.label: Teams meeting links
schema.description: Join links in invitations open in Omateams when it is installed, otherwise in the default browser.

schema.label: Save attachments to
schema.description: Folder for downloaded attachments; empty means ~/Downloads.

schema.label: Re-skin Outlook with the Omarchy theme
schema.description: Maps Outlook's design tokens to your theme's colors.toml and follows theme switches live, light or dark. Off leaves Outlook with Microsoft's own look.

schema.label: Use the shell font
schema.description: Renders Outlook in the same monospace family as the bar and menus. Off keeps Outlook's default sans-serif. Message bodies keep the fonts their sender chose.

schema.label: Closing the window
schema.description: Hide keeps Outlook running for the badge, notifications and reminders; Quit ends the process.

schema.label: Reload Outlook in the background above (MB)
schema.description: Outlook grows over a long session. Once its page uses more than this, and half again as much as it took when fresh, it is reloaded while the window has been out of sight for ten minutes, no popout is open and no message is being written, at most once an hour. 0 never reloads.

schema.label: Outlook URL
schema.description: https://outlook.live.com/mail/ for a personal Outlook.com account. Change it only if your organisation uses a different endpoint (GCC: outlook.office365.us).
